discription: An expressive lead sound using a filtered saw wave with an ADSR envelope applied to both amplitude and filter cutoff frequency.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, cutoff=4000, rq=0.5, attackTime=0.01, decayTime=0.1, sustainLevel=0.8, releaseTime=1.0, filterAttack=0.01, filterDecay=0.2, filterSustain=0.5, filterRelease=0.5, filterModAmt=1.5;    var sig, ampEnv, filterEnv;    ampEnv = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(attackTime, decayTime, sustainLevel, releaseTime, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    filterEnv = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(filterAttack, filterDecay, filterSustain, filterRelease, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 0    );    var actualCutoff = cutoff * (1 + (filterEnv * filterModAmt));    sig = Saw.ar(freq);    sig = RLPF.ar(sig, actualCutoff.max(50), rq);    sig = sig * amp * ampEnv;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
